cohort: 16 inspected Izu vascular-plant taxa from the failed frozen transfer; outcomes may evaluate the procedure but may not enter support selection

method.support_rule: within each training fold, leave out each thinned training prototype in turn; choose the smallest support quantile whose remaining prototypes recover at least 80% of omitted training prototypes in NDVI-state space; if no q<1 meets the target, use q=1 and fall back to pure geographic coverage
method.selector: greedy maximum newly covered public land-grid cells among support-eligible centers

controls.global_max_coverage: q=1.0 with identical K and radius
controls.fixed_q10_max_coverage: the only fixed-q development signal surviving the preceding decomposition

decision.goal: replace a universal fixed support threshold with one universal training-only decision procedure
decision.success_pattern: adaptive support should retain or improve the low-budget ecological lift without using held-out coordinates and should automatically revert toward q=1 when the training occurrences do not support a narrow environmental envelope
decision.if_failure: do not stop development; diagnose whether the missing transferable state is multi-modal support, scale choice, or route/patch geometry before creating a new confirmation cohort

hard_boundaries: Held-out coordinates are invisible until q and every selected set are frozen.
No Campanula field coordinate enters the procedure.
Frozen 192 Practical Core taxa remain untouched.
No confirmation or superiority claim is allowed from this run.
